_evidence.classification_note: Unit of measurement = one `message_agent` tool call (one DM attempt); rows grouped by tool_call_id so the two-row storage form (truncated [message_agent] summary + real result) is not double-counted. delivered = status queued/settled/delivered/ok/success with no error/reason (accepted by the gateway); failed = error present (with or without a delivery_id, e.g. reason 'unknown') or status/reason in a known-failure set (runtime_unavailable 'NOT sent', ambiguous 'admission could not be confirmed'); unknown = anything else (kept in the total, lowers the rate conservatively). IMPORTANT: 'delivered' = accepted/queued by the gateway -- not consumption by the recipient; a queued DM can still be dropped before the recipient reads it (see phase-gate false-positive). A normally-delivered DM is unlinked from the outbox on settle, so the outbox corroborates only the pending/failed side.
